svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin hatched film covers three thin dark pads and the flat oxide between them. After it a thick pale oxide covers everything; its top is a little higher over the pads than between them.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a thin hatched film covers three thin dark pads and the flat oxide between them. After it a thick pale oxide covers everything; its top is a little higher over the pads than between them.
svg.text: A thick undoped oxide is deposited
After: an inter-level oxide over everything
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
